name: Lilamon
main_effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. It can't unsuspend until their turn ends. Then, by trashing 2 bottom face-down cards from under any of your Tamers, this Digimon may digivolve into a [DATA SQUAD] trait Digimon card in the hand without paying the cost.
source_effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon with [Rosemon] in its name or the [DATA SQUAD] trait would leave the battle area, by trashing the bottom face-down card from under any of your Tamers, it doesn't leave.
set_name: ST-24: Starter Deck Digimon Data Squad
